bossRule.warn: Begins with a large shield; bring sustained damage
At 40% HP, attack speed and damage rise sharply
Summons weak adds that distract the frontline
Periodically jumps to the backline
Reduces healing received by all enemies hit
Lightning bounces between clustered heroes
Taunts the frontline and gains defence while taunting
Teleports behind the team, attacks the weakest backliner
Stacking burn; cleansing and healing matter
Three phases: shield, add wave, enrage
